key_insight: ElectrochemLLM converts scientific PDFs into structured electrochemical records, linking literature extraction to electrolyte property prediction.
engineering_relevance: The pipeline can support materials screening by organizing electrolyte compositions, electrode materials, cell configurations, and measured properties into reusable datasets.
method: Combine hybrid document parsing with vision-capable LLM orchestration.
Extract verifiable records across text, tables, and figures.
Train electrolyte property prediction models using the curated ElectroChemDB.
evidence_signal: The pipeline reports an F1 score of 0.97 on the battery-electrolyte subset of a manually annotated 232-paper benchmark and was applied to 15,000 electrochemical research articles.
watch_item: The reported F1 applies to a benchmark subset; extraction accuracy across other electrochemical domains and downstream prediction performance require further validation.
paper_title: ElectroChemLLM: A Multimodal LLM Pipeline for High-Fidelity Electrochemical Informatics
